title: Large Language Models for Mental Health Applications: A Systematic Review

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review of literature identifying demographic skews and the underrepresentation of older age groups in social media training datasets used for LLM mental health screening.

Systematic review of literature highlighting the overrepresentation of English-speaking populations and evaluating the drop in model accuracy when applied to non-English datasets (e.g., Polish, Chinese, Portuguese, and Malay).
